reviewItem.question: Does "Added support for honouring Destination Rule Certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services instead of Metadata certificates" mean a change to env-var:istio|name=PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for using Destination Rule certificates instead of metadata certificates for MESH_EXTERNAL services, controlled via the PREFER_DESTINATIONRULE_TLS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SERVICES environment variable.
